name: Universidade do Algarve
summary: Public university in Faro; its own bachelor's are in Portuguese. It hosts SeaBluE students in year two but does not admit its first year.

ib.text: EU/EEA applicants to UAlg's own bachelor's use Portugal's national contest; those degrees are taught in Portuguese.

notes: SeaBluE is not a first-year UAlg option: students start in Cádiz, Naples or Gdańsk; Cádiz starters spend year two in Faro.
UAlg's 47 own undergraduate pages identify their teaching language; none offers a complete English route.
